get_config_md4_text8: get the default MD4 training config for the text8 dataset with vocab size 27 and 1000 timesteps
sweep_md4_text8_hyperparams: sweep MD4 text8 config with varied learning rate, dropout rate, and weight decay hyperparameters
build_md4_text8_config: build a config dict for training MD4 on text8 with cosine learning rate schedule and 1M training steps
test_md4_text8_config: test the MD4 text8 config returns a ConfigDict with correct dataset, model type, and batch size
review_md4_text8_sweep: review the MD4 text8 sweep function that adds work units with learning_rate 5e-4 and dropout_rate 0.05
